al-austin.text: "Families deserve clean, reliable water at a price they can afford. Our community deserves leaders who understand how to balance fiscal responsibility with long-term investments."

source.title: Random Lengths News: Al Austin launches campaign for WRD board (2026-06-30)

al-austin.text: Per his campaign launch, priorities include protecting groundwater, managing ratepayer dollars responsibly, investing in infrastructure, and "preparing for future droughts and climate challenges."

source.title: Random Lengths News: Al Austin launches campaign for WRD board (2026-06-30)

mike-murchison.text: Endorsed by the Western States Regional Council of Carpenters (CARPAC).

source.title: Mike Murchison for Water Replenishment District (campaign site)

mike-murchison.text: "As we continue to battle record droughts and climate change, we must create a sustainable system that protects our water resources."

source.title: Mike Murchison for Water Replenishment District (campaign site)

mike-murchison.text: "Every dollar should be accounted for; spending should be transparent, and infrastructure investments should deliver results."

source.title: Mike Murchison for Water Replenishment District (campaign site)
